claim: Kaspa never runs your app, it only verifies it: that is how you get real apps on proof-of-work money with no L2 in the middle.
why_this_claim: It is the screenplay's stated ONE idea (THE HOOK / THESIS: 'Kaspa does not run the app, Kaspa verifies it') and it survives cold because every word it needs is in three self-contained lines: the hook names the thing (vProgs, real apps on the base layer, not an L2), the 'four jobs' block proves the mechanism and lands the exact claim ('What it never does is run the app. The app runs on its own nodes.'), and the CH3 hammer line is the payoff in the same words as the hook. Nothing depends on the Ethereum-rollup contrast, the ladder dates, or the Sompolinsky quotes, so all of CH2 Beat 1 and CH3 Beats 1-2 can be left on the floor without a dangling referent.
